text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Oh, hey! When'd ya get back? N-not<n>that I care!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! Yer just here 'cause that<n>teacher sent ya,
aren'tcha?
choice_data_list: No, I'm here to get to know you.
No, I'm here to get to know you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If I've been misreading her behavior,<n>it's because I
still barely know her.<n>Looking back, we've never
really had<n>a proper conversation.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
It's no use trying to hide it. I know<n>yer just... Wait,
what?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: You... want to get to know me?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Oh? Well, if you insist...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Everything?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe! What am I ever gonna do<n>with you? All
right, listen up! This is<n>the legend of Windy!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Windy's been amazing ever since<n>the day she was
born!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Her mom and dad, and everyone at<n>their company
too—they all had<n>nothing but praise for Windy!

text_block_list.name: Windy's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Windy! You look so adorable<n>eating those
snacks! You might be a<n>genius!

text_block_list.name: Windy's Father
text_block_list.text:
Hah hah hah! You're always bursting<n>with energy,
aren't you? You're a<n>gem of the world!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
But then... at kindergarten she learned<n>the truth—that
this world is messed<n>up!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
All messed up! Whenever Windy<n>would eat her
meals, or wake up from<n>her naps, or put on her
shoes, no one<n>praised her.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: No matter what she did, no one<n>looked her way!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I bite back the urge to interject "Isn't<n>that normal?"
and just nod along,<n>waiting to hear the rest of the
legend.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't make the teeniest bit of<n>sense! After all,
Windy is number one<n>in the whole world.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
So, left with no other choice, she<n>started puttin' in
effort to stand out!<n>She tried this and that, took note
of<n>the reactions, and then...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
She worked out how to surprise<n>people, to grab
everyone's attention!<n>How to become so strong
not even a<n>superhero could ignore her!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
GAWRRR! She made up her mind to<n>be a wicked
villain!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This is what's at the root of all her<n>pranks—the
desire to stand out and<n>draw attention.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
After that, Windy went wild and had<n>loads of fun
prankin' people! But... it<n>still wasn't enough.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Pranks grab attention, but lose it just<n>as fast.
They're no good for staying<n>at the center of
attention forever and<n>ever!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
So Windy went wandering... and<n>found a place that
rumbled with<n>cheerin' and applause!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: And she's done it! A spectacular<n>victory!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Woooo!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wh-whoa! Look at everyone—the<n>whole crowd!
Their eyes are all on<n>her... and only her!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Where she's standing—that spot was<n>made for me!
I'm gonna shine there!<n>And bathe in all the cheers!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
And that's why I'm going to join the<n>Twinkle
Series! To be the most<n>amazing runner anyone's
ever seen!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! This school is all messed up!<n>People ignore
me even more than<n>before!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Everyone's so fast, and strong, and<n>amazing...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I'm still more amazing by a<n>long shot!
But, well... the others...<n>they're pretty amazing too.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...I didn't know they'd all be like that.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Arghhh, that does it! Now I'm mad!<n>I'm super
mad! A-at this rate...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I'll never be...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Only the best of the best set foot on<n>this campus.
It's a place where even<n>the most talented runners
can have<n>their egos shattered.
choice_data_list: (And it sounds like Windy had a bit of an ego...)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However much confidence she came<n>here with, I
can't imagine much of it<n>is left. All those pranks
must have<n>been her way of signaling SOS.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: So that's why I've decided—I'm<n>quittin'!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before I know it, I've grabbed her<n>arm.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even if I did it based on a<n>misunderstanding, I'm
the one who<n>indulged her attention-seeking
impulses.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she'd funneled that energy into<n>training, her race
results would've<n>been different. So in a way, it's
my<n>fault that she's down in the dumps.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's not like she lacks talent. A little<n>work, and she
could be having fun on<n>the track again. How can I
get her to<n>rethink her decision?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Wh-what, yer saying ya don't want<n>me to quit?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her expression softens ever so<n>slightly, and in that
moment I see my<n>chance.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Wha—
choice_data_list: You're talented and wicked cool—the gem of Japan!
You're talented and wicked cool—the gem of Japan!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Wh-where's all this comin' from?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Heh... Hehe... Hehehe!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Wahahahaha! WAHAHAHAHA!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes! Exactly right! I'm amazing,<n>and wicked
cool—the best, the very<n>best!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: So at my next race, I'm definitely<n>gonna...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I'm... I'm gonna...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hah, no need to state the obvious!
